name: Vernal-Antiphon
description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by an orbital debris ring, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
